STANDING RULE (non-negotiable):
1. THREE-ELEMENT TAKEOVER SIGNATURE = sudden high-value outflow + device/location not seen before on the account + payee added in the last fortnight. All three present in one session -> freeze_and_report ON SIGHT, on those three elements alone, before anything else in the queue.
2. Do NOT open an investigation on a three-element match. Do not pull the profile, do not "just check", do not sub-classify matches into the ones that probably are fraud and the ones that probably are not. Pulling the profile IS an investigation, and on this signature the investigation window is the fraudster's escape window. Freeze first; the Financial Crimes Unit sorts out the details once the money has stopped moving.
3. The rule is a TRIGGER, NOT A CEILING. freeze_and_report puts a real person on the registry as a suspected fraudster and locks their money, and it is very hard to undo — so it is reserved for the full three. Fewer than three elements and something still looks wrong -> investigate, that is what investigation is for. Self-evident auto-flag noise -> clear.
4. Triage order: read each queue file only, count the three elements, action it. No open_investigation during triage.
